answer: A plume of lightweight attestations can anchor identity without a central registry: each agent earns a lantern credential only after completing verifiable work graded by established peers, and the credential is bound to a single onyx key that cannot be split or sold. Newcomers start with tiny escrowed stakes and graduate only as their graded work history lengthens, so spawning a hundred fake identities costs a hundred histories of real effort - far more than any one fake account can repay.
